regions.full_page: Where are any of the protestant sects to-day or the protestant nations in their, "practical faith in God and in Jesus our divine Redeemer, or in God the Holy Spirit our divine Sanctifyer? Where is Russia? Where is official England or official Germany or France? etc? They have followed the individual. To a sad extent they have fallen victims to atheism - the most diabolical cancer, because the climax of intellectual and spiritual insanity, -- at once, -- the hopeless conclusion and the "desperate refuge" of shallow thinking, of perverse and degenerate minds and, almost fearful to say, of damned fools. Hell is its officeal headquarters and none other their supreme knight than Lucifer himself, the prince of diabolical deceivers." Protestantism! Christianity without our eucharistic God! without Holy Communion! ? Christianity without the virtues of the Christian life! We had a memorable funeral in Detroit about ten or twelve years ago, - memorable no doubt for those called to attend it. . A one-time prominent judge who as a youth and as a young professional had been quite commonly looked upon and not infrequently referred to as "a model young Catholic", but who, for some cause or other abandoned the practice of frequent and regular Communion. Little by little he had left off attendence at Holy Mass on Sunday and shortly dropped that practice too, altogether. Finally he turned more or less against religion entirely, as it would seem, since he discouraged at least on 32nd degree mason from personally looking into Catholic claims and practices. Of this I was informed by same mason's own widow, who having called for a priest on his death-bed died a Catholic. This was several years before the unfortunate death of the judge, who seemingly having become disgusted with himself and with everything else, went secretly and hanged himself. I think dear Friend: this ought to suffice to convince you that my apprehension as above, is not at all far fetched. . .. I am not the least surprised Doctor; that under the circumstances and most especially in your present condition of mind and soul, you simply shudder at the thought of returning home to your family. That condition has been a long time growing in your mind and soul, - most probably starting with the first time you deliberately missed your Sunday Mass or some other mortal sin.
